Name: Tractor Garage Mod - Victorian Style (Now with Seasonal Option)
Author: Pir8tHunt3rZ0r0
Description:
Modded the tractor garage from Pathoschild's awesome tractor mod to fit the victorian style from Eemie. Wanted the garage to fit the current aesthetic of the farm, and thought I would share in case others would like to use the same style. I am not aware of any visual bugs, but if you see any, let me know.

[b]To Install: [/b]Just drag and drop this garage.png file into Mods/TractorMod/Assets and overwrite the current image.

[b]To Install Seasonal Option: [/b]Just replace the assets folder in mods/TractorMod/ with the my Assets folder.

Downloads.Description: If you want a seasonal version of the garage, download this and save it to the TractorMod folder. It can overwrite the existing folder "assets" or you can paste the individual .png files into mods/tractormod/assets
